measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The evaluation focused on general problem-solving (world knowledge, complex instructions, arithmetic, programming, causality), writing ability (informative, professional, argumentative, creative), and alignment to human values (helpfulness, honesty, harmlessness).
